name: interview
description: Claude asks you questions in a pane beside the chat and keeps working: pick an option or write your own words, and each answer reaches Claude in its running turn, or as your next message once the turn has ended.

askUserQuestion.title: Send AskUserQuestion to the Interview pane
askUserQuestion.description: Claude's own AskUserQuestion calls go to the Interview pane and return at once, so Claude keeps working. A number question still opens Claude Code's own form.
